title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (890 affected)
summary: THE TRACK CONTROL ARMS USED TO SUPPORT THE FRONT WHEELS WERE IMPROPERLY WELDED IN THE AREA OF THE FLEXIBLE BUSHING MOUNTING HOLE. THIS CAUSES A GRADUAL OPENING OF THE MOUNTING HOLE AND LOOSENING OF THE BUSHING.

title: Glaval Bus: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (1,010 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE FOR THE REAR BENCH SEAT FAILED TO COMPLY WITH THE STANDARDS OF FMVSS 210.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:PUMP (35 affected)
summary: THE POWER STEERING PUMP IS IMPROPERLY CALIBRATED AND HAS INSUFFICIENT POWER STEERING FLUID FLOW FOR THE OPERATION OF THE STEERING SYSTEM.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES (237 affected)
summary: EXPOSED TURN-DOWN ENDINGS AT THE BEAD TOE CAN ALLOW AIR TO PERMEATE INTO THE TIRE'S CARCASS CAUSING SEPARATION AND PREMATURE FAILURE.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:WHEEL WELL SPARE COVER (8/82) (654,000 affected)
summary: CHILDREN CAN ACCIDENTALLY LOCK THEMSELVES IN THE FOOTWELL AREA OF THE REAR-FACING THIRD SEAT, OR IN THE STORAGE COMPARTMENT IN STATION WAGONS NOT EQUIPPED WITH AN OPTIONAL THIRD SEAT. ONCE THE COMPARTMENT IS CLOSED IT CANNOT BE OPENED FROM THE INSIDE.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (33 affected)
summary: THE OPTIONAL REMOTE ENTRY MODULE MAY HAVE A FAULT WHICH CAUSES RANDOM ACTUATION OF INTERIOR LAMPS, DOOR LOCKS, AND/OR TAILGATE RELEASE. THIS ACTUATION MAY OCCUR WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN USE OR UNATTENDED.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:INSTRUMENT PANEL:OTHER PART (39 affected)
summary: THE INSTRUMENT PANEL ILLUMINATION INTENSITY CONTROL AND THE HEATER/AIR-CONDITIONER WINDSHIELD DEFROSTING AND DEFOGGING CONTROLS CANNOT BE SEEN OR OPERATED FROM THE DRIVER POSITION.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:CHAMBER:BRAKE (1,500 affected)
summary: A CRACK IN THE DIE CAST ALUMINUM HOUSING OF THE BRAKE CHAMBER CAUSES A LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE IN THE CHAMBER. LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE CAUSES THE SPRING BRAKES TO BE APPLIED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (17,000 affected)
summary: THE HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY INSTALLED AND THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH MAY BE PREVENTED FROM ENGAGING WHEN THE HOOD IS CLOSED.

title: ALFA ROMEO, INCORPORATED: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:COURTESY LIGHTS (1,800 affected)
summary: AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT  CAN DEVELOP IN THE GLOVE COMPARTMENT MAPLIGHT.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:UNKNOWN TYPE:INJECTION MANIFOL (812 affected)
summary: THE ALUMINUM FUEL LINE FITTINGS ON CERTAIN FUEL INJECTION LINES CORRODE, CAUSING THE FUEL LINE FITTINGS TO BREAK.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: STEERING:COLUMN (645 affected)
summary: THE UPPER STEERING COLUMN LOCKNUT WAS MANUFACTURED WITH INFERIOR MATERIALS AND INFERIOR SELF-LOCKING PROPERTIES.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: STEERING:GEAR BOX (182 affected)
summary: THE STEERING BOX EXTENSION FASTENERS WERE MANUFACTURED WITH INFERIOR MATERIAL.

title: General Motors, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT (146 affected)
summary: VEHICLES WERE INCORRECTLY EQUIPPED WITH STANDARD REAR WINDOWS INSTEAD OF THE NECESSARY RIVETED INSTALLATION SEAL ASSEMBLIES.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (25,000 affected)
summary: THE REAR BRAKE LINES HAVE INADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE BRAKE TUBE AND THE VEHICLE UNDERBODY IN THE AREA OF THE LEFT REAR WHEEL OPENING.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: BRAKES:AIR LINES AND FITTINGS (24 affected)
summary: A BRAKE AIR LINE PLUMBING ERROR CAUSES THE SPRING BRAKES TO BE APPLIED WITHOUT BRAKE APPLICATION WHEN THE AIR PRESSURE IN THE PRIMARY TANK DROPS TO A LEVEL WHICH AUTOMATICALLY ACTIVATES THE SPRING BRAKE SYSTEM.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (1,995 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE BRAKE LINKAGE BELLCRANK END NUTS ARE NON-LOCKING NUTS, AND CAN LOOSEN IN SERVICE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STEERING:LINKAGES (9,434 affected)
summary: VARIANCES IN THE LOCATION OF THE TIE ROD ARM BOLT HOLES AND STEER AXLE SPINDLE MOUNTING HOLES RESULT IN THE ATTACHING BOLTS BEING INCORRECTLY TORQUED. THIS CAUSES THE TIE ROD ATTACHING BOLTS TO FAIL RESULTING IN SEPARATION OF THE TIE ROD FROM THE STEERING AXLE SPINDLE.
